== Biography ==

The Mock Turtle is a creature of Wonderland whose nature is sharp and easily provoked. He speaks with quick rebuke to those he considers foolish, commanding Alice to hold her tongue without hesitation. Yet for all his acerbic manner, he possesses genuine knowledge of Wonderland's customs, most notably the Lobster Quadrille, with all its peculiar steps and choreography. He is exacting about clarity in conversation, becoming indignant when others speak without proper explanation, dismissing such efforts as 'by far the most confusing thing I ever heard.' There is melancholy in him, too—according to Alice's memory of Wonderland, his heavy sobs could be heard even from a distance.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. They encounter one another on several occasions in Wonderland, with Alice seeking the Mock Turtle's knowledge of the realm's creatures and customs.

'''[[Gryphon]]''' — ally. The two are frequent companions, moving about Wonderland together, with the Gryphon addressing the Mock Turtle with familiar authority.
